description.name: Basic Attack: Gale Hammer Combo
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launch up to 3 Strikes forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
During the 3rd attack, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate <color=#ffffff>[Basic Attack: Meteor Hammer]</color>;
During the 3rd attack, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to directly activate <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Riding the Wind]</color>.

description.name: Basic Attack: Meteor Hammer
description.desc:
<color=#ffffff>[Basic Attack]</color> After the 3rd hit, or when <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Rising Wind]</color> or <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Riding Wind]</color> ends without any <color=#ffffff>[Wind Energy]</color>, automatically activates:
Delivers a powerful Strike downward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.

description.name: Basic Attack: Whirlwind Hammer
Dodge: Tailwind
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
Perform a quick dodge to the side.

description.name: Dash Attack: Wind Chaser
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Strike forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.

description.name: Dodge Counter: Headwind
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Special Attack: Wind Gather
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Strike forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.

description.name: EX Special Attack: Riding the Wind
EX Special Attack: Wind Cannon
Eye of the Wind
description.desc:
<color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Wind Cannon]</color> Generated after consuming <color=#ffffff>[Wind Energy]</color>, lasts 30 seconds;
A maximum of 3 <color=#ffffff>[Wind Eyes]</color> can exist simultaneously. When this limit is exceeded, the earliest generated <color=#ffffff>[Wind Eye]</color> will automatically detonate;
When hit by <color=#ffffff>[Basic Attack: Cyclone Hammer]</color> or <color=#ffffff>[Ultimate: Storm Rampage]</color>, they will be detonated. If fewer than 3 are hit simultaneously, a small tornado will be generated at each <color=#ffffff>[Wind Eye]</color> position, tracking enemies and dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color> for 2 seconds;
If 3 are hit simultaneously, a large tornado will be generated instead, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color> for 1 second.
When detonated by any means, <color=#ffffff>[Wind Eyes]</color> deal <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color> to nearby enemies.

description.name: Chain Attack: Storm Incoming
description.desc:
When a <color=#ffffff>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies ahead, dealing massive <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
After using this skill, recovers 1 <color=#ffffff>Wind Energy</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Ultimate: Storm Rampage
description.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Assist: Counter
description.desc:
Automatically activates when switching in after a Defensive Assist:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Quick Assist: Gale Cover
description.desc:
When the on-field character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Strikes forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Defensive Assist: Wind Wall
description.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Assist Follow-Up: Windbreak
description.desc:
After launching <color=#ffffff>[Defensive Assist]</color>, Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches a Strike forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.

1.name: Cinema I
1.desc: When <color=#ffffff>[Eye of the Storm]</color> is detonated by any means, DMG dealt is increased by 15% and Daze is increased by 15%; when <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Wind Cannon]</color> hits, reduces the enemy's All-Attribute RES by 15% for 50s.

2.name: Cinema II
2.desc: For each <color=#ffffff>[Wind Eye]</color> detonated, the next <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Ride the Wind]</color> gains 5% increased Daze, up to a max of 15%. When switching characters upon activating <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Ride the Wind]</color>, Roxy will maintain <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Ride the Wind]</color> for 0.5s without consuming Energy, up to a max of 1.5s. When <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Rising Wind]</color> or <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Ride the Wind]</color> hits an enemy, increases the enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier by 20%, lasting until the target recovers from the Stunned state.

4.name: Cinema 4
4.desc: When <color=#ffffff>[Basic Attack: Gale Combo Hammer]</color> hits an enemy, recover 1 Energy, up to 1 time per skill; when <color=#ffffff>[Dodge Counter: Headwind]</color>, <color=#ffffff>[Entry Skill]</color>, or <color=#ffffff>[Basic Attack: Meteor Hammer]</color> hits an enemy, recover 2 Energy, up to 1 time per skill; <color=#ffffff>[Ultimate: Storm Rampage]</color> DMG increases by 25%, and Daze increases by 10%.

6.name: Cinema 6
6.desc: When <color=#ffffff>[Basic Attack: Whirlwind Hammer]</color> detonates <color=#ffffff>[Eye of the Storm]</color> to generate a large tornado, the main target is granted the <color=#ffffff>[Vengeance]</color> effect, generating a large tornado at the target's position every 3 seconds for a total of 4 additional large tornadoes; the DMG Multiplier of large tornadoes is increased by 400%, and the Daze inflicted is increased by 100%. Upon repeated triggers, the additional generation count stacks.
